## NODE char_osiris Character "Osiris" "Book of the Dead" "spell 1"
summary: God of the afterlife, resurrection, and fertility; murdered and restored, ruler of the Duat.

## NODE char_isis Character "Isis" "Book of the Dead" "spell 1"
summary: Goddess of magic, sister and wife of Osiris, mother of Horus.

## NODE char_set Character "Set" "Book of the Dead" "spell 1"
summary: God of chaos and storms, slayer of Osiris, adversary of Horus.

## NODE char_horus Character "Horus" "Book of the Dead" "spell 1"
summary: Falcon-headed sky god, son of Osiris and Isis, avenger of his father.

## NODE char_anubis Character "Anubis" "Book of the Dead" "spell 125"
summary: Jackal-headed god of mummification and guide of the dead in the Duat.

## NODE place_duat Place "The Duat" "Book of the Dead" "spell 125"
summary: The Egyptian underworld, realm of the dead through which the sun travels at night.

## NODE event_weighing Event "Weighing of the Heart" "Book of the Dead" "spell 125"
summary: The judgment of the deceased, whose heart is weighed against the feather of Ma'at.

## NODE concept_maat Concept "Ma'at" "Book of the Dead" "spell 125"
summary: The cosmic order, truth, and justice, personified as a goddess and symbolized by a feather.

## NODE obj_ankh Object "Ankh" "Book of the Dead" "spell 1"
summary: The symbol of life, held by gods and offered to the king.

## NODE char_ra Character "Ra" "Book of the Dead" "spell 1"
summary: The sun god, creator and king of the gods; sails his solar barge across the sky by day and through the underworld by night; fought the serpent Apep/Apophis each night.

## NODE char_thoth Character "Thoth" "Book of the Dead" "spell 125"
summary: Ibis-headed god of wisdom, writing, and magic; scribe of the gods; records the result of the weighing of the heart; inventor of hieroglyphs and patron of scribes.

## NODE char_apep Character "Apep (Apophis)" "Book of the Dead" "spell 125"
summary: The chaos serpent; enemy of Ra; attempts to devour the solar barge each night in the underworld; embodiment of chaos and darkness, defeated but never destroyed.

## NODE char_nut Character "Nut" "Book of the Dead" "spell 1"
summary: The sky goddess; arches over the earth as a naked woman covered in stars; mother of Osiris, Isis, Set, and Nephthys; swallows the sun each evening and gives birth to it each morning.

## NODE char_geb Character "Geb" "Book of the Dead" "spell 1"
summary: The earth god; father of Osiris, Isis, Set, and Nephthys; separated from his wife Nut by Shu, the air god; laughter causes earthquakes.

## NODE char_bastet Character "Bastet" "Book of the Dead" "tradition"
summary: Cat goddess of home, fertility, and protection; daughter of Ra; her cult center was Bubastis; fierce protector against evil and disease.

## NODE char_ptah Character "Ptah" "Book of the Dead" "tradition"
summary: Creator god of Memphis; god of craftsmen and architects; created the world through the heart and the tongue (thought and speech); patron of artisans.

## NODE char_ammit Character "Ammit" "Book of the Dead" "spell 125"
summary: The devourer; a chimera of crocodile, lion, and hippopotamus; waits beside the scales of Ma'at during the weighing of the heart; devours the souls of the unworthy.

## NODE place_heliopolis Place "Heliopolis" "Book of the Dead" "tradition"
summary: The great solar city; cult center of Ra and the Ennead; where the creation myth of Atum and the first gods was told; one of the oldest religious sites in Egypt.

## NODE place_field_reeds Place "Field of Reeds (Aaru)" "Book of the Dead" "spell 125"
summary: The Egyptian paradise; the heavenly afterlife realm for the justified dead; an eternal version of the Nile valley where the worthy cultivate and feast.

## NODE obj_solar_barge Object "Solar Barge of Ra" "Book of the Dead" "spell 1"
summary: The boat on which Ra travels through the sky by day and the underworld by night; defended by gods against Apep; the dead assist in its defense.

## NODE obj_feather_maat Object "Feather of Ma'at" "Book of the Dead" "spell 125"
summary: The white feather of truth against which the deceased's heart is weighed; if the heart is lighter, the soul is justified; if heavier, it is devoured by Ammit.

## NODE event_night_journey Event "Ra's Night Journey" "Book of the Dead" "spell 1"
summary: Each night Ra's solar barge descends into the Duat; he battles Apep, passes through twelve gates guarded by serpents, and is reborn at dawn; the dead can aid his passage.
